groups.defect: The migration dereferences missing category-setting query results before its fallback can run, also leaves the fallback lookup unguarded, and matches the legacy category value against a name despite its reported ID contract.
groups.rationale: All report the same initial nil dereference and unreachable fallback. Members additionally report the unsafe fallback query and category ID/name mismatch, which must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: Legacy host values are inserted without scheme/path normalization, making them unmatchable after migration, and their unescaped SQL interpolation breaks inserts containing apostrophes.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same migration normalization defect. s_3284f51d additionally reports unsafe SQL quoting.

groups.defect: Host update/delete actions dereference missing records, and save_host dereferences an absent embeddable_host request payload.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same missing-record checks and missing request-payload guard. The merged comment must retain both defects.

groups.defect: The category and embeddable-host fabricator files contain each other's definitions.
groups.rationale: These describe the identical file-content swap from opposite files. Correcting it requires restoring the definitions in both files.

groups.defect: Plural hydration deletes raw IDs and installs unresolved lookup entries when side-loaded records are missing; it also calls map on null values, and its array fallback cannot activate.
groups.rationale: Both report destructive hydration when lookups fail. s_a74fdd01 additionally explicitly reports the null-value crash and ineffective fallback.

groups.defect: The expandable_first_post? spec retains a vacuous test for removed host-dependent behavior, and its nested describe misspells embeddable.
groups.rationale: Both report the same stale test and why its assertion passes without exercising its stated condition. s_c050f347 additionally reports the describe typo.
